title: [Feature Flag Smith Feature Tasks Kanban Enabled Prd] Finished lane for terminal outcomes
description: As an operator, I want completed and blocked tasks grouped in Finished so I can confirm closed outcomes and detect failures.

blockers.reason: Required task-management prerequisite failed: `td usage --new-session` could not run because `td` is not installed (`td: command not found`). Work paused per instruction.
Go verification/tooling blocker: `go` and `gofmt` are not installed in this environment, so backend tests/format checks for terminal metadata changes could not be executed.

stories.title: Group completed tasks in Finished lane
stories.i_want: tasks with terminal success outcomes to appear in the Finished lane
stories.so_that: I can verify completed work from one location
acceptance_criteria: Given a task status changes to completed, when the board refreshes, then the task appears in Finished.
Given a completed task appears in Finished, when viewed, then it is not shown in non-terminal lanes.
Given multiple completed tasks exist, when sorted in Finished, then all are visible and selectable.

stories.title: Group blocked tasks in Finished lane
stories.i_want: tasks with terminal blocked outcomes to appear in the Finished lane
stories.so_that: I can detect failures without scanning active lanes
acceptance_criteria: Given a task status changes to blocked, when the board refreshes, then the task appears in Finished.
Given a blocked task appears in Finished, when viewed, then it remains clearly marked as blocked.
Given blocked tasks exist, when filtering for Finished, then blocked items are included in results.

stories.title: Preserve terminal reason metadata in Finished
stories.i_want: each Finished task to show whether it ended as completed or blocked
stories.so_that: I can quickly interpret closure outcomes
acceptance_criteria: Given a Finished task, when opened, then terminal outcome type is displayed as completed or blocked.
Given a blocked outcome, when viewing task details, then the block reason field is visible if provided.
Given mixed terminal outcomes, when scanning Finished, then each item has an outcome indicator.

stories.title: Support feature-flag gating for Finished lane behavior
stories.i_want: Finished lane grouping to follow the kanban feature flag state
acceptance_criteria: Given the kanban feature flag is enabled, when terminal tasks exist, then completed and blocked tasks are grouped in Finished.
Given the kanban feature flag is disabled, when terminal tasks exist, then Finished lane grouping behavior is not active.
Given flag state changes, when the board reloads, then lane behavior matches the current flag state.

stories.title: Validate Finished lane counts and auditability
stories.i_want: Finished lane counts to reflect all completed and blocked tasks
stories.so_that: I can trust board totals and audit closed outcomes
acceptance_criteria: Given terminal tasks are present, when viewing Finished lane header, then count equals completed plus blocked tasks.
Given a terminal task transitions back to active, when the board refreshes, then Finished count decreases accordingly.
Given an audit check, when comparing task list and count, then no Finished task is omitted or duplicated.
